scene.name: papers/c2_ball_maze

task.name: papers
task.sentence: Steer the ball through the maze to its goal by tilting the board with both hands.
task.protocol: One maze (s4, 5 x 5 cells) and one ball, from cell A1 to the goal hole at A5; the episode ends once the ball rests in the cup, when it leaves the board, or at the task's cap of 300 s.
task.pass_rule: Passed when the ball has rested in the cup under the goal hole for 0.5 s (slower than 0.05 m/s on the board) and the task's 1 s hold, before the cap and without leaving the board.

scene.description: Sprout in front of a wooden tilt maze on a stand, both open hands beside its side tabs; a steel ball waits in the start corner. An overhead tracker reports the ball's position (the head camera cannot range it near the board's front edge).
